release_notes:
Hotfix release.

• Share intent: fix cold-start from the system share sheet getting stuck on the login route — the editor now opens reliably once authenticated.
• Build: restore a clean Kotlin compile by clearing leftover merge-conflict markers in six files.
release_notes_zh:
Bug 修复版本。

• 分享：修复从系统分享菜单冷启动 App 时停留在登录页的问题，登录后能正常打开编辑器。
• 构建：清理 6 个文件中遗留的合并冲突标记，恢复 Kotlin 编译。
